request.initial_prompt: King. And England, if my love thou hold'st at aught,— As my great power thereof may give thee sense, Since yet thy cicatrice looks raw and red After the Danish sword, and thy free awe Pays homage to us,—thou mayst not coldly set Our sovereign process, which imports at full, By letters conjuring to that effect, The present death of Hamlet. Do it, England; For like the hectic in my blood he rages, And thou must cure me. Till I know 'tis done, Howe'er my haps, my joys were ne'er begun.

King, and England, if my love thou holdst thee at aught, as my great power thereof may
give thee sense, since yet thy psychiatrist looks raw and red after the Danish sword,
and thy free awe pays homage to us, thou mayst not coldly set our sovereign process, which
imports at full by letters conjuring to that effect, the present death of Hamlet.
Do it, England, for like the hectic in my blood he rages, and thou must cure me, till
I note his done, how ere my haps, my joys were ne'er begun.
